'''Argullians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]], located in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth Sector]].

==Biology==
Being a near-[[Human/Legends|human]] species, Argullians were superficially similar to humans, but could be distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-colored [[Eye|irises]] and their broad, flat noses.

==History==
Argullians evolved on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet Argul, eventually pursuing [[Mining/Legends|mining]], [[farm]]ing, science and [[Technology (Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian)|technology]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Argullians were [[Death|killed]] during the [[Battle of Argul]], prompting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to initiate mass evacuations from the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]] which were seeing the most violence.
